### Make Correlogram to determine correlated variables
```{r - corr}
cor_df <- sp_temp_full_df_4 %>%
  select(trap_id, t_week, tot_wmel, mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1,
         log_tot_aegypti_lag1, log_tot_aegypti_lag2, 
         wmel_prev_lag1, wmel_prev_lag2, wk_avg_tmin_lag1, wk_avg_tmin_lag2, wk_avg_tmin_lag3,
         wk_avg_tmin_lag4, wk_avg_tmin_lag5, wk_avg_tmean_lag1, wk_avg_tmean_lag2,
         wk_avg_tmean_lag3, wk_avg_tmean_lag4, wk_avg_tmean_lag5, wk_avg_tmax_lag1,
         wk_avg_tmax_lag2, wk_avg_tmax_lag3, wk_avg_tmax_lag4, wk_avg_tmax_lag5,
         wk_avg_precipmean_lag1, wk_avg_precipmean_lag2, wk_avg_precipmean_lag3,
         wk_avg_precipmean_lag4, wk_avg_precipmean_lag5, wk_avg_precipmean_lag6,
         wk_avg_precipmean_lag7, wk_avg_precipmean_lag8, pop_sum, mean_income, hhmean_income,

  filter(!(is.na(trap_id) | is.na(t_week) | is.na(tot_wmel) | 
           is.na(mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1) | is.na(log_tot_aegypti_lag1) | is.na(log_tot_aegypti_lag2) |
         is.na(wmel_prev_lag1) | is.na(wmel_prev_lag2) | is.na(wk_avg_tmin_lag1) |

         is.na(wk_avg_tmin_lag4) | is.na(wk_avg_tmin_lag5) | is.na(wk_avg_tmean_lag1) |
         is.na(wk_avg_tmean_lag2) |

         is.na(wk_avg_precipmean_lag3) |

         is.na(wk_avg_precipmean_lag6) |

         is.na(mean_income) | is.na(hhmean_income) |
         is.na(prop_minwage) | is.na(prop_hhminwage) | is.na(imperv_perc) | is.na(ugs_perc) |
         is.na(elev))) %>%

  arrange(t_week)
```

### Cross correlation functions to determine lags of temporally-varying factors to test
```{r - ccf}
compute_ccf <- function(data) {
  ccf_result <- ccf(data[,4], data$tot_wmel, plot = FALSE)
  return(ccf_result)
}


trap_ids <- as.data.frame(sp_temp_full_df_4) %>%
  #select(-(geometry)) %>%
  select(trap_id) %>%
  distinct(trap_id)

trap_id <- unique(sp_temp_full_df_4$trap_id)

## log mozzies rel
mozzies_rel_df <- as.data.frame(sp_temp_full_df_4) %>%
  #select(-(geometry)) %>%
  select(trap_id, week.date, tot_wmel, mozzies_rel_plus1) %>%
  mutate(log_mozzies_rel_plus1 = log(mozzies_rel_plus1)) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(log_mozzies_rel_plus1))) %>%
  arrange(week.date)

mozzies_rel_df_result <- data.frame()

# Loop over each unique trap_id
for(id in trap_id){
  mozzies_rel_df_1 <- mozzies_rel_df %>%
    filter(trap_id == id)
  
   # Check if the data frame is not empty and has sufficient observations
  if(nrow(mozzies_rel_df_1) > 1) {
    # Compute the cross-correlation function
    ccf_res <- ccf(mozzies_rel_df_1$log_mozzies_rel_plus1, mozzies_rel_df_1$tot_wmel,
                   lag.max = 8, plot = FALSE, na.action = na.omit)
    
    # Create a temporary data frame to hold the results for the current trap_id
    temp_result <- data.frame(
      trap_id = id,
      lag = ccf_res$lag,
      acf = ccf_res$acf
    )
  } else {
    # If no data, add a row with NAs for this trap_id
    temp_result <- data.frame(
      trap_id = id,
      lag = NA,
      acf = NA)
  }
  # Append the temporary results to the main results data frame
  mozzies_rel_df_result <- rbind(mozzies_rel_df_result, temp_result)
}

# get thresholds
N <- nrow(mozzies_rel_df_result)
thresh <- 1.96 / sqrt(N)
mozzies_rel_df_result$thresh <- thresh


# get the average acf per lag
mozzies_rel_df_2 <- mozzies_rel_df_result %>%
  group_by(lag) %>%
  summarize(avg_acf = mean(acf, na.rm = T), 
            avg_thresh = mean(thresh, na.rm = T)) %>%
  filter(lag <= 0)

# plot
ggplot(mozzies_rel_df_2) +
  geom_point(aes(x = lag, y = avg_acf), size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(x = lag, y = avg_thresh), col = "blue", lty = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(x = lag, y = -avg_thresh), col = "blue", lty = 2) +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14))+
  labs(x = "No. wMel Released* Lag (week)", y = "Average CCF (grouped by trap)")
#ggsave("ccfs/mozzies_rel_ccf.pdf", dpi = 1200, width = 7, height = 5, units = "in")

    filter(trap_id == id)
  
   # Check if the data frame is not empty and has sufficient observations

    # Compute the cross-correlation function
    ccf_res <- ccf(min_temp_df_1$wk_avg_tmin, min_temp_df_1$tot_wmel,
                   lag.max = 8, plot = FALSE, na.action = na.omit)
    
    # Create a temporary data frame to hold the results for the current trap_id
    temp_result <- data.frame(
      trap_id = id,
      lag = ccf_res$lag,
      acf = ccf_res$acf
    )
  } else {

    temp_result <- data.frame(
      trap_id = id,
      lag = NA,
      acf = NA)
  }
  # Append the temporary results to the main results data frame
  min_temp_df_result <- rbind(min_temp_df_result, temp_result)
```

## Spatiotemporal Model Set Up
```{r - sp models}
# Set up Mesh
spatial.range <- 22000

mesh_2 = inla.mesh.2d(loc=as.matrix(sp_temp_full_df_4[,c("x","y")]), 
                    max.edge=c(spatial.range/5, spatial.range),
                    cutoff = 200,
                    offset=c(spatial.range/5, diff(range(sp_temp_full_df_4[,c("x")]))/10))

# Plot the mesh
plot(mesh_2, main = "INLA Mesh")
# Add points to the plot to see original data locations
points(sp_temp_full_df_3$x, sp_temp_full_df_3$y, col = 'red', pch = 19)

## Smooth spatial field
spde <- inla.spde2.matern(mesh=mesh_2) # alpha=2 

##Stack creation and inla analysis
s.index <- inla.spde.make.index(name="spatial.field", n.spde=spde$n.spde) 

A.est = inla.spde.make.A(mesh=mesh_2,
                         loc=as.matrix(sp_temp_full_df_4[,c("x","y")]))


stack = inla.stack(data=list(obs=sp_temp_full_df_4$tot_wmel),
                       A=list(A.est, 1),
                       effects=list(spatial_field = data.frame(s.index, Intercept=1),
                                    sp_temp_full_df_4[,-8]), # tot_wmel
                       tag='stdata')

```

## Main SP Model
```{r}

mod_sp_fig <- obs ~ -1 + Intercept + binary_mozzies_rel_lag1 + log(mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1) + wmel_prev_lag1 + wmel_prev_lag2 + f(tot_aegypti_lag1_bin, model = "rw2") + f(tot_aegypti_lag2_bin, model = "rw2") + f(wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin, model = "rw2") + f(imperv_bin, model = "rw2") + f(popdens_bin, model = "rw2") + f(elev_bin, model = "rw2") + f(income_bin, model = "rw2") + f(t_week, model = "ar1") + offset(log_tot_aegypti) + f(spatial.field, model = spde)


result_sp_fig <- inla(mod_sp_fig,
                data=inla.stack.data(stack),
                family="nbinomial",
                control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stack), compute = T), 
                control.fixed=list(expand.factor.strategy='inla'),
                control.compute=list(config = TRUE, dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE),
                verbose=T) 

```

```{r}
## Covariate median (range) on the model data
d <- as.data.frame(sp_temp_full_df_4)
vars <- intersect(c("tot_wmel", "tot_aegypti", "mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1", "wmel_prev_lag1",
                    "wk_avg_tmin_lag4", "wk_avg_tmax_lag1", "wk_avg_tmean_lag1", "wk_avg_precipmean_lag1",
                    "mean_income", "hhmean_income", "prop_minwage", "prop_halfminwage",
                    "prop_hhminwage", "prop_hhhalfminwage", "pop_sum", "elev", "imperv_perc", "ugs_perc"),
                  names(d))
sapply(d[, vars], function(x) sprintf("%.1f (%.1f–%.1f)", median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                      min(x, na.rm = TRUE), max(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
mean(d$binary_mozzies_rel_lag1, na.rm = TRUE)  # proportion of trap-weeks with releases
max(d$t_week)                                   # number of weeks

## Priors actually used and hyperparameter posteriors
inla.priors.used(result_sp_fig)
v <- result_sp_fig$summary.hyperpar 

## Matérn range and marginal SD on the natural scale
spde_res <- inla.spde2.result(result_sp_fig, "spatial.field", spde)
inla.zmarginal(spde_res$marginals.range.nominal[[1]])
inla.zmarginal(inla.tmarginal(sqrt, spde_res$marginals.variance.nominal[[1]]))
```



## Figure SP linear and nl covariates
* get coefficient effects using the marginal posterior distribution summaries to get an interpretable effect
* since need to exponentiate, the effect is no longer a linear transformation
* allows you to propogate uncertainty through nonlinear relationships 
```{r - 4b}
## time varying abundance
mod_linear <- result_sp_fig$summary.fixed

### binary mozzies_rel
bin_mozzies_rel_marg <- result_sp_fig$marginals.fixed$binary_mozzies_rel_lag1

set.seed(123)
beta_samples_1 <- inla.rmarginal(1000, bin_mozzies_rel_marg)

effect_samples_1 <- exp(beta_samples_1)

bin_mozzies_rel_df <- data.frame(
  name = "binary_mozzies_rel_lag1",
  ID = NA,
  mean_effect  = mean(effect_samples_1),
  lower_effect = quantile(effect_samples_1, 0.025),
  upper_effect = quantile(effect_samples_1, 0.975))

### wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin -- 15.9 18.5 22.3 20.6 24.0
wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin_marginals <- result_sp_fig$marginals.random$wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin

names(wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin_marginals)

set.seed(123)
wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin_marginals), function(idx_name) {
  
  # Extract that bin’s marginal posterior
  marg <- wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin_marginals[[idx_name]]
  
  # Sample from the posterior
  beta_samples <- inla.rmarginal(1000, marg)
  
  # Exponentiate to get multiplicative effect (since it’s usually on log-link)
  effect_samples <- exp(beta_samples)
  
  # Summarize posterior
  data.frame(
    name = "wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin",
    ID = idx_name,
    mean_effect  = mean(effect_samples),
    lower_effect = quantile(effect_samples, 0.025),
    upper_effect = quantile(effect_samples, 0.975))}))

  # Extract that bin’s marginal posterior
```

#### Fig S6 - Spatial Field 
```{r}
release_areas <- read_sf("~/Documents/Yale EMD/Year 2/Rio Data Analysis/Data/simplified_release_areas_paloma.gpkg") |> 
  st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=23 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"))

coords <- spde$mesh$loc

xrange <- seq(min(coords[, 1]), max(coords[, 1]), length.out = 100)
yrange <- seq(min(coords[, 2]), max(coords[, 2]), length.out = 100)

grid <- expand.grid(x = xrange, y = yrange)
coordinates(grid) <- ~x + y
proj_grid <- inla.mesh.projector(spde$mesh, xlim = range(xrange), ylim = range(yrange), dims = c(100, 100))


#mod1_nl_spatial_field <- readRDS("data/mod1_nl_spatial_field.rds")
mod_rw1_nl_spatial_field <- result_sp_fig_rw1$summary.random$spatial.field

spatial_mean <- inla.mesh.project(proj_grid, mod_rw1_nl_spatial_field$mean)
spatial_lb <- inla.mesh.project(proj_grid, mod_rw1_nl_spatial_field$`0.025quant`)
spatial_ub <- inla.mesh.project(proj_grid, mod_rw1_nl_spatial_field$`0.975quant`)

grid$mean <- as.vector(spatial_mean)
grid$lb <- as.vector(spatial_lb)
grid$ub <- as.vector(spatial_ub)

grid_sf <- as.data.frame(grid) |> 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), remove = FALSE, crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=23 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")) |> 
  mutate(sig = case_when(lb > 0 & ub > 0 ~ 1,
                         lb < 0 & ub < 0 ~ 1,
                         .default = 0)) |> 
  st_intersection(release_areas)

grid_sf |>
  #filter(sig == 1) |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = release_areas, fill = "gray25", color = "gray25") +
  geom_tile(aes(x = x, y = y, fill = exp(mean))) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#CE263D", mid = "white", high = "#25489E", midpoint = 1, 
                       limits = c(0.1237208, 5.0786130)) +
  #scale_fill_gradientn(colors = pal, na.value = "transparent") +
  geom_sf(data = release_areas, fill = NA, color = "black", lwd=1.2)+
  theme_void() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(color = "white", fill = "white"), 
        plot.background = element_rect(color = "white", fill = "white"))+
  labs(fill = "Spatial Field Mean") 

ggsave("figure_rw1_spatial_field.jpg", dpi = 1200)
```

```{r}
  marg <- wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin_marginals_mnthly[[idx_name]]
  
  # Sample from the posterior
  beta_samples <- inla.rmarginal(1000, marg)

  effect_samples <- exp(beta_samples)
  
  # Summarize posterior
  data.frame(
    name = "wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin",
    ID = idx_name,
    mean_effect  = mean(effect_samples),
```

### Fig S8 - Sensativity Analysis: Yearly AR1
```{r}
mod_yrly <- obs ~ -1 + Intercept + binary_mozzies_rel_lag1 + log(mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1) + wmel_prev_lag1 + wmel_prev_lag2 + f(tot_aegypti_lag1_bin, model = "rw2") + f(tot_aegypti_lag2_bin, model = "rw2") + wk_avg_precipmean_lag2 + wk_avg_precipmean_lag5 + wk_avg_precipmean_lag6 + wk_avg_precipmean_lag7 + wk_avg_precipmean_lag8 + f(wk_avg_tmin_lag1_bin, model = "rw2") + f(wk_avg_tmin_lag2_bin, model = "rw2") + f(wk_avg_tmin_lag3_bin, model = "rw2") + f(wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin, model = "rw2") + f(wk_avg_tmin_lag5_bin, model = "rw2") + f(imperv_bin, model = "rw2") + f(popdens_bin, model = "rw2") + f(elev_bin, model = "rw2") + f(hhincome_bin, model = "rw2") + f(t_year, model = "ar1") + offset(log_tot_aegypti) + f(spatial.field, model = spde)

                data=inla.stack.data(stack),
                family="nbinomial",

  marg <- tot_aegypti_lag1_bin_marginals_yrly[[idx_name]]
  
  # Sample from the posterior
  beta_samples <- inla.rmarginal(1000, marg)
  
  # Exponentiate to get multiplicative effect (since it’s usually on log-link)
  effect_samples <- exp(beta_samples)
  
  # Summarize posterior
  data.frame(
    name = "tot_aegypti_lag1_bin",
    ID = idx_name,
    mean_effect  = mean(effect_samples),
    lower_effect = quantile(effect_samples, 0.025),
    upper_effect = quantile(effect_samples, 0.975))}))
```

### Fig S9 - Sensativity Analysis: 50m trap radius 
```{r - 50m radius}
## Set up mesh and stack
### Set up Mesh
spatial.range <- 22000

mesh_50 = inla.mesh.2d(loc=as.matrix(sp_temp_full_50_2[,c("x","y")]), 
                    max.edge=c(spatial.range/5, spatial.range),
                    cutoff = 200,
                    offset=c(spatial.range/5, diff(range(sp_temp_full_50_2[,c("x")]))/10))

### Smooth spatial field
spde_50 <- inla.spde2.matern(mesh=mesh_50) 

### Stack creation and inla analysis
s.index.50 <- inla.spde.make.index(name="spatial.field", n.spde=spde_50$n.spde) 

A.est.50 = inla.spde.make.A(mesh=mesh_50,
                         loc=as.matrix(sp_temp_full_50_2[,c("x","y")]))


stack_50 = inla.stack(data=list(obs=sp_temp_full_50_2$tot_wmel),
                       A=list(A.est.50, 1),
                       effects=list(spatial_field = data.frame(s.index.50, Intercept=1),
                                   sp_temp_full_50_2[,-8]), # tot_wmel
                       tag='stdata')

## Formula
mod_50m_2 <- obs ~ -1 + Intercept + binary_mozzies_rel_lag1 + log(mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1) + wmel_prev_lag1 + wmel_prev_lag2 + f(tot_aegypti_lag1_bin, model = "rw2") + f(tot_aegypti_lag2_bin, model = "rw2") + f(wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin, model = "rw2") + f(imperv_bin, model = "rw2") + f(popdens_bin, model = "rw2") + f(elev_bin, model = "rw2") + f(income_bin, model = "rw2") + f(t_week, model = "ar1") + offset(log_tot_aegypti) + f(spatial.field, model = spde_50)

## Model 
result_50m_2 <- inla(mod_50m_2,
                data=inla.stack.data(stack_50),
                family="nbinomial",
                control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stack_50), compute = T), 
                control.fixed=list(expand.factor.strategy='inla'),
                control.compute=list(config = TRUE, dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE),
```

### Fig S10 - Sensativity Analysis: 200m trap radius
```{r - 200m radius}
## Set up mesh and stack
spatial.range <- 22000

mesh_200 = inla.mesh.2d(loc=as.matrix(sp_temp_full_200_2[,c("x","y")]), 
                    max.edge=c(spatial.range/5, spatial.range),
                    cutoff = 200,
                    offset=c(spatial.range/5, diff(range(sp_temp_full_200_2[,c("x")]))/10))

### Smooth spatial field
spde_200 <- inla.spde2.matern(mesh=mesh_200) # alpha=2 

### Stack creation and inla analysis
s.index.200 <- inla.spde.make.index(name="spatial.field", n.spde=spde_200$n.spde) 

A.est.200 = inla.spde.make.A(mesh=mesh_200,
                         loc=as.matrix(sp_temp_full_200_2[,c("x","y")]))


stack_200 = inla.stack(data=list(obs=sp_temp_full_200_2$tot_wmel),
                       A=list(A.est.200, 1),
                       effects=list(spatial_field = data.frame(s.index.200, Intercept=1),
                                   sp_temp_full_200_2[,-8]), # tot_wmel
                       tag='stdata')

## Formula
mod_200m_2 <- obs ~ -1 + Intercept + binary_mozzies_rel_lag1 + log(mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1) + wmel_prev_lag1 + wmel_prev_lag2 + f(tot_aegypti_lag1_bin, model = "rw2") + f(tot_aegypti_lag2_bin, model = "rw2") + f(wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin, model = "rw2") + f(imperv_bin, model = "rw2") + f(popdens_bin, model = "rw2") + f(elev_bin, model = "rw2") + f(income_bin, model = "rw2") + f(t_week, model = "ar1") + offset(log_tot_aegypti) + f(spatial.field, model = spde_200)

## Model 
result_200m_2 <- inla(mod_200m_2,
                data=inla.stack.data(stack_200),
                family="nbinomial",
                control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stack_200), compute = T), 
                control.fixed=list(expand.factor.strategy='inla'),
                control.compute=list(config = TRUE, dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE),
                verbose=T) # DIC = 73252.03, WAIC = 73291.06

    mean_effect  = mean(effect_samples),
```

### Fig S11 - Sensativity Analysis: Vehicle Releases Only 
```{r - Vehicle releases}
## Set up mesh and stack
spatial.range <- 22000

mesh_v = inla.mesh.2d(loc=as.matrix(sp_temp_full_v2[,c("x","y")]), 
                    max.edge=c(spatial.range/5, spatial.range),
                    cutoff = 200,
                    offset=c(spatial.range/5, diff(range(sp_temp_full_v2[,c("x")]))/10))

### Smooth spatial field
spde_v <- inla.spde2.matern(mesh=mesh_v) # alpha=2 

### Stack creation and inla analysis
s.index.v <- inla.spde.make.index(name="spatial.field", n.spde=spde_v$n.spde) 

A.est.v = inla.spde.make.A(mesh=mesh_v,
                         loc=as.matrix(sp_temp_full_v2[,c("x","y")]))


stack_v = inla.stack(data=list(obs=sp_temp_full_v2$tot_wmel),
                       A=list(A.est.v, 1),
                       effects=list(spatial_field = data.frame(s.index.v, Intercept=1),
                                   sp_temp_full_v2[,-8]), # tot_wmel
                       tag='stdata')

## Formula
mod_v2 <- obs ~ -1 + Intercept + binary_mozzies_rel_lag1 + log(mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1) + wmel_prev_lag1 + wmel_prev_lag2 + f(tot_aegypti_lag1_bin, model = "rw2") + f(tot_aegypti_lag2_bin, model = "rw2") + f(wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin, model = "rw2") + f(imperv_bin, model = "rw2") + f(popdens_bin, model = "rw2") + f(elev_bin, model = "rw2") + f(income_bin, model = "rw2") + f(t_week, model = "ar1") + offset(log_tot_aegypti) + f(spatial.field, model = spde_v)

## Model 
result_v2 <- inla(mod_v2,
                data=inla.stack.data(stack_v),
                family="nbinomial",
                control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stack_v), compute = T), 
                control.fixed=list(expand.factor.strategy='inla'),
                control.compute=list(config = TRUE, dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE),
                verbose=T) # DIC = 22111.42, WAIC = 22099.58
```

### Fig S12 - Sensativity Analysis: Random Sample of Space-Time Observations
```{r - subsample of observations}
## DF set-up
### Set the seed for reproducibility 
set.seed(123)

### Calculate the number of rows to sample
sample_size <- floor(0.5 * nrow(sp_temp_full_df_4))

### Generate random row indices for the 80% subsample
sample_indices <- sample(seq_len(nrow(sp_temp_full_df_4)), size = sample_size)

### Create the subsample data frame
subsample_df <- sp_temp_full_df_4[sample_indices, ]

## Set up mesh and stack
spatial.range <- 22000

mesh_s = inla.mesh.2d(loc=as.matrix(subsample_df[,c("x","y")]), 
                    max.edge=c(spatial.range/5, spatial.range),
                    cutoff = 200,
                    offset=c(spatial.range/5, diff(range(subsample_df[,c("x")]))/10))

### Smooth spatial field
spde_s <- inla.spde2.matern(mesh=mesh_s) # alpha=2 

### Stack creation and inla analysis
s.index.s <- inla.spde.make.index(name="spatial.field", n.spde=spde_s$n.spde) 

A.est.s = inla.spde.make.A(mesh=mesh_s,
                         loc=as.matrix(subsample_df[,c("x","y")]))


stack_s = inla.stack(data=list(obs=subsample_df$tot_wmel),
                       A=list(A.est.s, 1),
                       effects=list(spatial_field = data.frame(s.index.s, Intercept=1),
                                   subsample_df[,-8]), # tot_wmel
                       tag='stdata')

## Formula
mod_s2 <- obs ~ -1 + Intercept + binary_mozzies_rel_lag1 + log(mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1) + wmel_prev_lag1 + wmel_prev_lag2 + f(tot_aegypti_lag1_bin, model = "rw2") + f(tot_aegypti_lag2_bin, model = "rw2") + f(wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin, model = "rw2") + f(imperv_bin, model = "rw2") + f(popdens_bin, model = "rw2") + f(elev_bin, model = "rw2") + f(income_bin, model = "rw2") + f(t_week, model = "ar1") + offset(log_tot_aegypti) + f(spatial.field, model = spde_s)


## Model 
result_s2 <- inla(mod_s2,
                data=inla.stack.data(stack_s),
                family="nbinomial",
                control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stack_s), compute = T), 
                control.fixed=list(expand.factor.strategy='inla'),
                control.compute=list(config = TRUE, dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE),
                verbose=T) # DIC = 36881.97, WAIC =  36896.26


## Model plot
bin_mozzies_rel_marg_s2 <- result_s2$marginals.fixed$binary_mozzies_rel_lag1

set.seed(123)
beta_samples_1 <- inla.rmarginal(1000, bin_mozzies_rel_marg_s2)

effect_samples_1 <- exp(beta_samples_1)

bin_mozzies_rel_s2_df <- data.frame(
  name = "binary_mozzies_rel_lag1",
  ID = NA,
  mean_effect  = mean(effect_samples_1),
  lower_effect = quantile(effect_samples_1, 0.025),
  upper_effect = quantile(effect_samples_1, 0.975))

### "log_mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1"
```

### Fig S14 - Sensitivity analysis: scaled figures 
```{r}
## scale variables
sd_scale <- function(x) x / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)

sp_temp_full_df_s13 <- sp_temp_full_df_4 %>%
  mutate(log_mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1_sd = sd_scale(log(mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1)),
         wmel_prev_lag1_sd = sd_scale(wmel_prev_lag1),
         wmel_prev_lag2_sd = sd_scale(wmel_prev_lag2))

### SDs on the original scale for the plot labels
s13_sd <- c(log_mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1 = sd(log(sp_temp_full_df_4$mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1), na.rm = TRUE),
            wmel_prev_lag1 = sd(sp_temp_full_df_4$wmel_prev_lag1, na.rm = TRUE),
            wmel_prev_lag2 = sd(sp_temp_full_df_4$wmel_prev_lag2, na.rm = TRUE))

## update stack
stack_s13 = inla.stack(data=list(obs=sp_temp_full_df_s13$tot_wmel),
                       A=list(A.est, 1),
                       effects=list(spatial_field = data.frame(s.index, Intercept=1),
                                    dplyr::select(sp_temp_full_df_s13, -tot_wmel)), 
                       tag='stdata')

## Formula
mod_fig_s13 <- obs ~ -1 + Intercept + binary_mozzies_rel_lag1 + log_mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1_sd + wmel_prev_lag1_sd + wmel_prev_lag2_sd + f(tot_aegypti_lag1_bin, model = "rw2") + f(tot_aegypti_lag2_bin, model = "rw2") + f(wk_avg_tmin_lag4_bin, model = "rw2") + f(imperv_bin, model = "rw2") + f(popdens_bin, model = "rw2") + f(elev_bin, model = "rw2") + f(income_bin, model = "rw2") + f(t_week, model = "ar1") + offset(log_tot_aegypti) + f(spatial.field, model = spde)

## Model 
result_fig_s13 <- inla(mod_fig_s13,
                data=inla.stack.data(stack_s13),
                family="nbinomial",
                control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stack_s13), compute = T), 
                control.fixed=list(expand.factor.strategy='inla'),
                control.compute=list(config = TRUE, dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE),
                verbose=T) 

#saveRDS(result_fig_s13, "data/result_fig_s13.rds")

## Model plots
### linear terms
s13_fixed <- function(term, name) {
  marg <- result_fig_s13$marginals.fixed[[term]]
  set.seed(123)
  beta_samples <- inla.rmarginal(1000, marg)
  effect_samples <- exp(beta_samples)
  data.frame(
    name = name,
    ID = NA,
    mean_effect  = mean(effect_samples),
    lower_effect = quantile(effect_samples, 0.025),
    upper_effect = quantile(effect_samples, 0.975))
}

### rw2 terms
s13_random <- function(term) {
  marginals <- result_fig_s13$marginals.random[[term]]
  set.seed(123)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(marginals), function(idx_name) {
    beta_samples <- inla.rmarginal(1000, marginals[[idx_name]])
    effect_samples <- exp(beta_samples)
    data.frame(
      name = term,
      ID = idx_name,
      mean_effect  = mean(effect_samples),

      upper_effect = quantile(effect_samples, 0.975))}))
}

## Bin medians in SD units 
bin_sd_medians <- function(bin, x) {
  z <- (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  data.frame(bin = bin, z = z) %>%
    filter(!is.na(bin)) %>%
    group_by(bin) %>%
    summarise(med_sd = median(z, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(bin) %>%
    pull(med_sd)
}

                  bin_sd_medians(s13_dat$popdens_bin, s13_dat$pop_sum),

  geom_hline(yintercept = 39.5, color = "black", alpha = 0.6)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 36.5, color = "black", alpha = 0.6)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 35.5, color = "black")
```

```{r}
idx_fit <- inla.stack.index(stack = stack, tag = 'stdata')$data

# main mod result_sp_fig
main_mod <- sp_temp_full_df_4  |> 
  mutate(fit = result_sp_fig$summary.fitted.values[idx_fit, "mean"],
         lb = result_sp_fig$summary.fitted.values[idx_fit, "0.025quant"],
         ub = result_sp_fig$summary.fitted.values[idx_fit, "0.975quant"]) 

lm_main <- lm(tot_wmel ~ fit, data = main_mod)
```
